fields.description: Upper half of the big-endian block-count word of the settings header block. Always 0x0000 when the record is valid; read as local_20 by FUN_0803255c.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803255c reads EEPROM block 0 via FUN_0803aea8; CONCAT22(local_20,local_16) over save bytes [0:4] is the validation loop bound. Upper half is 0x0000 in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: save_header_zero

fields.description: Lower half of the big-endian block-count word: total 8-byte EEPROM blocks in the settings record (header + data). Bounds the FUN_08032454 read loop in FUN_0803255c; validated by FUN_080325f0.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803255c sets uVar2 = CONCAT22(local_20,local_16) = 4 from save bytes [2:4] and loops FUN_08032454 while the block index is below it. Writer path is FUN_080324d8/FUN_0803b124.
fields.name: save_block_count

fields.description: Stored integrity word of the settings record. Equals the IEEE CRC32 over logical bytes [8:32] (settings blocks 1-3) with its two 16-bit halves swapped (rev16), matching the driver's byte-swapped u16 write convention. Schema v2 has no crc32 algorithm, so it is carried as a plain u32 field.
fields.evidence: FUN_08032454 folds every settings data block into a running CRC via FUN_08033fe8 inside FUN_0803255c (reader) / FUN_08032410 (writer). Python check: rev16(crc32_ieee(logical[8:32])) == stored u32_le 0x481fe80f in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: settings_crc32

fields.description: Upper half of the big-endian settings-record tag word. Always 0x0000 when the tag check passes; read as local_18 by FUN_0800919c.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800919c reads settings block 1 via FUN_08032454 and requires CONCAT22(local_18,local_16) == 3 over save bytes [8:12]; upper half is 0x0000 in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: settings_tag_hi

fields.description: Lower half of the settings-record tag word. Value 3 selects the settings-load path; any other value takes the re-initialization branch (FUN_08032650 + FUN_080007d8 + rewrite).
fields.evidence: FUN_0800919c checks CONCAT22(local_18,local_16) == 3 from save bytes [10:12]; mismatch falls into the else branch that restores defaults and rewrites the record.
fields.name: settings_tag

fields.description: Audio channel A level (0-255). Boot default is 0x40; applied through FUN_0803aaf0 when the mute flag is clear.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800919c stores (char)local_14 (save byte [12], low byte of the u16 at [12:14]) to settings struct +0x28. Boot FUN_080001e8 sets struct+0x28 = 0x40, and FUN_080002c0 passes struct+0x28 to FUN_0803aaf0.
fields.name: audio_level_a

fields.description: Upper byte of the audio-level-A word. Never consumed (only the low byte is stored) and always written as 0x00 by the rewrite path.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800919c only uses (char)local_14 from the u16 at save [12:14]; the else-branch rebuilds local_14 solely from the +0x28 byte, so this byte is always 0x00.
fields.name: reserved_13

fields.description: Audio mute flag (low byte of the u16 at save [14:16], stored to settings struct +0x24). Zero means the stored levels are applied; nonzero forces both channels to 0.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800919c stores local_12 & 0xff (save byte [14]) to settings struct +0x24. FUN_080002c0 applies FUN_0803aaf0/FUN_0803abe4 levels only when struct+0x24 == 0, else forces 0. Boot FUN_080001e8 defaults struct+0x24 = 0.
fields.name: audio_mute_flag

fields.description: Audio channel B level (0-255). Boot default is 0xff; applied through FUN_0803abe4 when the mute flag is clear.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800919c stores (char)(local_12 >> 8) (save byte [15], high byte of the u16 at [14:16]) to settings struct +0x29. Boot FUN_080001e8 sets struct+0x29 = 0xff, and FUN_080002c0 passes struct+0x29 to FUN_0803abe4.
fields.name: audio_level_b

fields.description: First word of the second settings block, byte-swapped into RAM audio-state buffer bytes [0:2]. Exact gameplay meaning is unconfirmed, but the offset/stride are fixed by the save/load record layout.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800919c reads settings block 2 via FUN_08032454 and copies local_18 byte-swapped to the RAM buffer (DAT_080092f8[0] = local_18 >> 8, [1] = local_18 & 0xff); the rewrite path rebuilds it from DAT_0800927c[0:2].
fields.name: settings_ext_word_0

fields.description: Second word of the second settings block, byte-swapped into RAM audio-state buffer bytes [2:4]. Exact gameplay meaning is unconfirmed.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800919c copies local_16 byte-swapped to the RAM buffer (DAT_080092f8[2] = local_16 >> 8, [3] = local_16 & 0xff); the rewrite path rebuilds it from DAT_0800927c[2:4].
fields.name: settings_ext_word_1

fields.description: Third word of the second settings block, byte-swapped into RAM audio-state buffer bytes [5:7] (buffer index 4 is preserved, never overwritten). Exact gameplay meaning is unconfirmed.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800919c copies local_14 byte-swapped to DAT_080092f8[5] and [6], skipping index 4; the rewrite path rebuilds it from DAT_0800927c[5:7].
fields.name: settings_ext_word_2

fields.description: Fourth word of the second settings block; only its high byte round-trips (stored to RAM buffer index 7, low byte is always written as zero). Exact gameplay meaning is unconfirmed.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800919c copies local_12 >> 8 to DAT_080092f8[7]; the rewrite path rebuilds local_12 solely from DAT_0800927c[7] << 8, so the low byte of save [22:24] is always 0x00.
fields.name: settings_ext_word_3
